name: music-converter-for-wasm
description: Static WebAssembly Music Converter & Metadata Studio powered by FFmpeg.wasm

scripts.sync-vendor: mkdir -p vendor/ffmpeg vendor/ffmpeg-util vendor/ffmpeg-core && cp -r node_modules/@ffmpeg/ffmpeg/dist/esm/* vendor/ffmpeg/ && cp -r node_modules/@ffmpeg/util/dist/esm/* vendor/ffmpeg-util/ && cp -r node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/esm/* vendor/ffmpeg-core/

author: MotoYucchi
